scientific_role: provider-exposed local SLA-compliance surface consumed unchanged by composition methods
phase1_dependency: read-only frozen Step-0 SLA accounting semantics and benchmark context
card_instance: I1_i=(A_i,W_i,R,{sigma_i(A_i,H;rho): H in H, rho in R})

local_metric_semantics.L_i: provider-local request arrival to provider completion, including provider queue waiting and service time
local_metric_semantics.C_i: native provider execution cost for the local request

workload_contract.semantics: same periodic root-request context as the frozen Phase-1 matched physical benchmark

rationale.0.9833333333333333: supports the predeclared equal three-branch M0 violation-budget reference without interpolation
rationale.0.99: strict intermediate contour useful for surface-constrained lifting

confidence.use_in_composition: M-specific; I1 exposes point estimate and interval but does not choose how either is consumed

A_i_selection.semantics: A_i is an exact query argument supplied by a consuming method and recorded in the resulting card instance
A_i_selection.fair_tau_rule: for a comparison, the exact same materialized I1 card instances must be supplied unchanged to M0 and M1
A_i_selection.anti_tuning_rule: a method must declare its requested A_i points without inspecting I1 sigma values or Phase-1 top-level white-box outcomes

forbidden_public_information: top-level Phase-1 white-box curves or outcomes
